scripts.setup: uv sync --project apps/api && uv sync --project packages/portfolio-risk --extra dev && bun install
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --reload-dir app --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.worker:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8002 --workers 1
scripts.db:init: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.storage_admin init-demo
scripts.build:native: uv run --project apps/api python scripts/build_native.py && uv run --project apps/api python scripts/build_ledger_native.py && uv run --project apps/api --with libclang --with cmake python scripts/build_decision_native.py
scripts.test: bun run test:py && bun run test:e2e
scripts.test:py: bun run test:engine && bun run test:api
scripts.test:engine: cd packages/portfolio-risk && uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests/ -q
scripts.test:api: cd apps/api && uv run --extra dev python -m pytest tests/ -q
